events.title: SHARDS Demo — big update: now much easier to learn
events.summary: The SHARDS demo just got a big update — it's much easier to learn. Huge thanks to everyone (and the streamers!) who played the demo and shared feedback. The #1 thing we heard was "it takes a while to click." So we rebuilt onboarding. What's new See the correct answer when you slip up. Get a puzzle wrong and the demo now highlights the right button for the Operator and the exact rule/cell the Guide should read — wrong options dim out, so the "aha" is instant. events.title: The SHARDS Demo is out now — play it free!
events.summary: The SHARDS Demo is out now — free. You can finally play SHARDS. Grab the demo from this page, bring a friend, and see if you can describe the indescribable. What's in the demo The free demo includes the first 3 sectors plus Free Play (Lv1–2). The full game adds all 20 sectors, every difficulty, extra modes (Stage Mode and the "Descent" roguelite), online co-op for up to 4 with extra roles (Suppressor, Decoder), and more. events.title: SHARDS is now on Steam — Wishlist now!
events.summary: Describe the indescribable. The SHARDS Steam page is live — and you can wishlist it right now. We're a small studio, LUMICROFT, and this is the game we've been quietly building. Thanks for being here early. What is SHARDS? A no-language, asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 players (best as a duo). You and your partner look at different screens and can never see each other's — only your voices connect you. Voice-only, asymmetric co-op — separate screens, different information. Nameless symbols
